description: [Requires login] Delete an entry from the authenticated user's own AniList list by its list-entry ID (NOT the media id) — get it from get_user_list. This cannot be undone, and calling it again on an already-deleted id errors rather than silently succeeding.

listEntryId.description: The list ENTRY id to delete (not the media id).

name: remove_list_entry
title: Remove an entry from your AniList list
